sources.publisher: Statistics South Africa / DataFirst, University of Cape Town
sources.title: General Household Survey 2025, Version 1
sources.geography: South Africa; provinces and metropolitan municipalities where applicable
sources.population_scope: Private households in nine provinces and residents of workers' hostels; other collective living quarters and military populations excluded
sources.rights_status: DataFirst metadata states Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY); cite dataset DOI and send DataFirst a copy/link to resulting publication. Exact file bytes not acquired.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Survey estimate for the stated population, period, sampling design and reported constructs; not continuous telemetry, person-level wealth accounts or causal impact.
notes: Two-stage stratified sampling using 2013 Master Sample; approximately 3,080 PSUs.
Use provided weights and design metadata; preserve PSU/cluster and strata.
Low-level disaggregation requires caution; provincial boundaries differ from older vintages.

sources.title: P0318 General Household Survey 2025 publication
sources.geography: South Africa; report-specific provincial and metropolitan coverage
sources.population_scope: GHS 2025 target population as defined by Stats SA
sources.rights_status: Stats SA publication/data-access terms must be reviewed before reproducing tables or redistributing artifacts.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Publisher-reported aggregate statistics and definitions; not raw continuous service measurements.
notes: Contains publication, presentation, weighted tables and selected 2002–2025 time series locators.

sources.title: Report 04-04-04 Benchmarked and rebased estimates of GDP, 2026
sources.geography: South Africa; provincial estimates in separate tables/release
sources.population_scope: National accounts aggregates and related tables
sources.rights_status: Stats SA publication/data-access terms require review; no permissive licence asserted.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Official revised national accounts for the stated vintage and reference period; not household-level welfare or a causal explanation.
notes: Real GDP is at constant 2022 prices; nominal GDP at current prices.
SARB notice confirms coverage 2018 Q1–2026 Q2; balanced production/expenditure/income series through Q3 2026 were scheduled for 15 December 2026.

sources.title: World Inequality Report 2026
sources.release_vintage: WIR 2026; South Africa country sheet includes 2024 estimates
sources.reference_period: country-sheet values are series-specific; cited South Africa summary year 2024
sources.population_scope: Population-wide distributional estimates under WID definitions
sources.rights_status: Report is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; underlying downloadable series may have separate terms. Review before copying/rehosting or commercial reuse.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Independent distribution estimates under WID definitions; not GHS household microdata and not directly joinable to survey records.
notes: Do not merge as person-level records or assume income/wealth concepts match GHS.
Preserve WID methodology, price/PPP basis, income/wealth definition and year.

sources.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.title: How's Life? 2024 — Well-being Framework
sources.geography: OECD framework; use as methodology comparator only
sources.population_scope: Framework dimensions, not a South African dataset
sources.rights_status: OECD publication terms apply; link and cite, do not mirror without permission review.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Measurement framework, not a source of South African household observations.
notes: Current well-being includes income/wealth, work, housing, health, skills, environment, safety, work-life balance, social connections, civic engagement and subjective well-being.
Future resources include economic, natural, human and social capital.

sources.title: System of Environmental-Economic Accounting — Ecosystem Accounting
sources.release_vintage: SEEA EA adopted 2021; web method page current at snapshot
sources.population_scope: Framework, not a South African microdataset
sources.rights_status: Use/copy terms to be checked for any substantial reproduction.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Framework for ecosystem extent, condition and ecosystem-service accounts; not a household well-being estimate.
notes: Keep physical and monetary ecosystem-service accounts separate.
